description: This file contains functions related to managing and repairing OAuth profiles, handling deprecated profiles, and providing hints and status updates for authentication issues within the 'openclaw' project. It includes logic for profile repair, removal of deprecated profiles, and health checks for auth profiles.

methods.name: maybeRepairLegacyOAuthProfileIds
methods.description: Repairs legacy OAuth profile IDs in the configuration by prompting the user to update mismatched profiles.

methods.name: pruneAuthOrder
methods.description: Removes profile IDs from the auth order that are no longer valid.

methods.name: pruneAuthProfiles
methods.description: Removes specified profile IDs from the auth profiles and order in the configuration.

methods.name: maybeRemoveDeprecatedCliAuthProfiles
methods.description: Detects and optionally removes deprecated CLI auth profiles from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveUnusableProfileHint
methods.description: Provides user hints for disabled or cooldown auth profiles based on reason.

methods.name: resolveAuthIssueHint
methods.description: Generates hints for specific auth issues, such as invalid tokens or other provider issues.

methods.name: formatAuthIssueLine
methods.description: Formats a detailed line describing an auth issue for display.

methods.name: noteAuthProfileHealth
methods.description: Checks and reports the health status of auth profiles, including cooldowns and token expiration, and prompts for token refresh if needed.
